question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
WITH yearly_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(collision_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) as year,
        pcf_violation_category,
        COUNT(*) as count
    FROM collisions
    WHERE collision_date IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND pcf_violation_category != ''
    GROUP BY year, pcf_violation_category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        pcf_violation_category,
        count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY count DESC, pcf_violation_category ASC) as rn
    FROM yearly_counts
),
top2_pairs AS (
    SELECT year, pcf_violation_category as cause
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 2
),
pairs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT year, cause1, cause2
    FROM (
        SELECT t1.year, t1.cause as cause1, t2.cause as cause2
        FROM top2_pairs t1
        JOIN top2_pairs t2 ON t1.year = t2.year AND t1.cause < t2.cause
    )
),
most_common_pairs AS (
    SELECT cause1, cause2, COUNT(*) as year_count
    FROM pairs
    GROUP BY cause1, cause2
    ORDER BY year_count DESC
),
unique_pairs AS (
    SELECT cause1, cause2
    FROM most_common_pairs
    WHERE year_count < (SELECT MAX(year_count) FROM most_common_pairs)
)
SELECT p.year, u.cause1, u.cause2
FROM pairs p
JOIN unique_pairs u ON p.cause1 = u.cause1 AND p.cause2 = u.cause2
